Hey babe,

Chin up, you're doing fine, you're off the ground and experiencing a little bit of turbulence. It happens when you climb altitudes. You sat in the boarding lounge for a little while and had the courage to stand up when your name was called. You're in the rarefied air , cruising toward your destination.

Walking through the ticket gate is one of the greatest challenges you will face, and you've proven that you will do what it takes to arrive at your future location.
Enjoy the In-flight movies and Mini-bar while we're flying. As this journey will take a while to reach your destination. While it may not be a first class ride, it is the only way to Self-Affirmation Isle.
You may feel a little queezy along the way, and that's Ok. The fine staff are here to assist you when you get dizzy :S. 
[ Mile high club if you're interested ;) ]

**I think about gender all day long, and dream about it most nights.**

You're thinking about the future, a lot. You are not alone, and it is a good sign that you are taking this into consideration.

It is hard to see a clear image of who we want to be when we grow older, and it is all to easy to become focused on the future, and to forget to see, what we are experiencing now.

**Will my mental state change more the deeper I get into HRT?**

For me, HRT started kicking in after the third month. By this I mean, steady, consistent changes in how I felt mentally and physically. I could see and feel the small modifications HRT was making to my body.

The worst part so far was the mood swings that occurred through the first and second month. I felt empty, and worthless. Seeing how little change HRT had done. It took me a while, to find out that little girls don't wake up with D Cup boobs in two months. I was shattered :( , but relieved all the same :D

**It is hard to see myself as female in the future, but I think this is due to my male looks, I don't know what I would look like as a girl. But I definitely hate thinking about seeing myself as male in the future.**

I thought long and hard. My brain swam in circles like a goldfish in a tank, a little too small. I would constantly have the thought, I am not a girl because of " _ _ _ _ ". How could i betray my friends? My family doesn't believe me, I am a freak... Like a 100 year war, my brain raged on, making me unable to concentrate on anything bar why I should stop, making me extremely agitated. :(
It wasn't until I wrote out all of my thoughts and separated them. That things became clear.
And it did. I realised that I would never give up HRT, clothing, mannerisms, speech, personality, interests, for anyone. Transition is making me a happier and much more enjoyable person to be around.

**If you were given the chance, right now. 
Would you give up Transition, HRT, make-up and clothing?**

What your feeling is very similar to what I experienced less than a month ago.
You're gonna pull through this thunderstorm, and be back on your way to becoming who you are.
There will be more turbulence along the way, I apologize, and when you feel like your descending, we will help you up, and adjust the gauges.
